title: UNDERLAY DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated in-memory PDF, DGN and DWF underlay transaction controls; no producer or support claim.

behavior: Stage body, string and handle destinations using the alias-aware entity transaction helper.
Preserve subtype selection, normal and inverse clip encoding, and the definition hard pointer.

assertions: Every measured allocation failure returns false without throwing and preserves seeded streams, counts, handle occurrences and previous type.
Same-object retry matches clean encoding; an all-stream alias failure and retry preserve state.

limitations: Generated controls establish transaction behavior only; physical producer, graph and native rendering qualification remain open.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
